CENTRAL COALFIELDS LIMITED (A Subsidiary of Coal India Limited)
ANNUAL OPERATIONAL HIGHLIGHTS — FINANCIAL YEAR 2023-24

Central Coalfields Limited (CCL) achieved raw coal production of 84.50 Million Tonnes in FY 2023-24, registering a remarkable growth of 9.03% over 77.50 MT achieved in FY 2022-23.
Total coal off-take during FY 2023-24 stood at 82.10 Million Tonnes against 75.30 MT in the preceding fiscal.
Net turnover from operations reached Rs. 14,250.60 Crores, yielding Profit Before Tax (PBT) of Rs. 2,890.15 Crores.
Composite Overburden Removal (OBR) scaled to 132.40 Million Cubic Metres (M.Cu.M), reflecting robust operational discipline.
